# Reader — your saved-link inbox

> Save links from the web. Find them, pull their content, and mark them read through ChatGPT.

Canonical: https://read.significanthobbies.com/

Your saved-link inbox

## Save a link. *Pick it up in ChatGPT.*

Keep the pages you want to come back to in one place. Add a URL, or save the current tab with the Chrome extension. ChatGPT can find your links, pull their content, and mark them read when you ask.

[Sign in to your inbox](https://read.significanthobbies.com/login)

[Connections](https://read.significanthobbies.com/extension)

Google sign-in · no checkout

![Reader's inbox with six saved links, read-state controls and an add-link button](https://read.significanthobbies.com/images/inbox.png)

Illustrative interface · example links, not a customer's inbox

## A saved tab is *only an intention.*

How it works

Reader keeps the list small: what you saved, whether you have read it, and a way back to it.

### Save it

Paste a URL in the inbox, or click Save link in the Chrome extension. Reader stores the title, the address and the date.

### Find it

Switch between unread, read and all. Search matches titles and addresses.

### Mark it

Links stay unread until you say otherwise. Opening or fetching a link never marks it read on its own.

## Ask about what you saved, *in the conversation you are already in.*

With ChatGPT

Reader connects to ChatGPT through MCP with OAuth. Reading and discussion happen there; Reader holds the list.

### Search

“What have I saved about databases?” finds matching links in your inbox.

### Fetch

Pulls the available text of a link. If a site blocks extraction, the original address is still there.

### Mark read

Marks a link read, or unread again, only when you ask. Read and write are separate permissions.

## Small on purpose, *and private to your account.*

Boundaries

Reader is a maintained personal tool. It does one job and does not grow past it.

### Google sign-in

Your inbox belongs to your account and is isolated from every other.

### Chrome extension

Saves the active tab's address and title. Built from source for a local unpacked install.

### Not in Reader

No RSS, annotations, boards, PDF capture or built-in AI. Earlier saves are kept and appear as links.

### No checkout

There is no public plan or payment.

## Before you *save a link.*





### How do I add a link?

Paste a URL in the inbox, or click Save link in the Chrome extension.

### What does ChatGPT see?

Only what its tools ask for: a search over your saved titles and addresses, the text of a link you point it at, and the read state of a link you ask it to change.

### Where did the other features go?

RSS, the reader view, annotations, boards, memories, PDFs and built-in AI are outside the active product. Existing saved data is retained.

### Can I install the Chrome extension?

It is built from the repository and loaded unpacked in Chrome. Public store distribution is deferred.

## Bring one link you mean *to come back to.*



Sign in with Google, paste the address, and it is waiting in your inbox.

[Sign in to your inbox](https://read.significanthobbies.com/login)

[How it connects](https://read.significanthobbies.com/faq)

# Reader — questions

> Reader saves links for use with ChatGPT.

Canonical: https://read.significanthobbies.com/faq

## Just your saved links.

### How do I add one?

Paste a URL in the inbox or click Save link in the Chrome extension.

### How does ChatGPT use it?

Connect Reader through MCP with OAuth. ChatGPT can search links, retrieve available text, and mark links read when you ask. The connection requires a deployed endpoint and OAuth setup.

### Where are the other features?

RSS, the reader view, annotations, boards, memories, PDFs, and built-in AI are outside the active product. Existing saved data is retained.

### Where is the extension?

It is built from this repository and loaded unpacked in Chrome. Public distribution is deferred.

# Reader — changes

> Reader’s saved-link simplification.

Canonical: https://read.significanthobbies.com/changelog

Product direction

## A smaller Reader.

The active product is a saved-link inbox, a one-click capture extension, and MCP tools for ChatGPT to retrieve links and update read state.

Existing saved data remains intact. Deployment and an authenticated ChatGPT connection are verified separately from source changes.

[Source history](https://github.com/Significant-Hobbies/reader/commits/main)

# Privacy

> How Reader handles sign-in, saved links, extension keys, ChatGPT access, and analytics.

Canonical: https://read.significanthobbies.com/privacy

Reader stores your Google sign-in identity and the links you save, including their titles and read states. Older saved material remains stored in your account.

The extension sends the current page’s URL and title only when you click Save link. Its connection key stays in Chrome’s local extension storage. Reader stores a hash of that key.

When you connect ChatGPT through MCP, it can retrieve your links and available source text, and update read states when you ask. Reader may fetch a saved URL to extract text. OpenAI’s privacy terms apply to information shared with ChatGPT.

Reader uses analytics and error monitoring to understand usage and failures. We do not sell your saved links.

Contact the maintainer to request removal of your account data.
